title: Settings
comingSoon: The full settings screen lands in a later phase.

webClipper.label: Web Clipper
webClipper.description: Create a new bookmark in your browser and paste this code into its URL field. Clicking it from any page opens Retenia to import it.

thirdPartyNotices.label: Third-party notices
thirdPartyNotices.description: Retenia uses these third-party components as separate processes or unmodified libraries. None of them changes the licence of Retenia's own code.

model.label: Memory model
model.never: Never optimised — trained on the published defaults. {reviews} reviews available.
model.trained: Optimised {date} on {reviews} reviews · log loss {logLoss} · RMSE {rmse}

result.applied: Applied: the new parameters predict better
result.rejected: Not applied: the new parameters do not predict better
result.noReschedule: No card moved. The new parameters apply from each card’s next review.

loadBalance.label: Balance the daily load
loadBalance.help: Within the same interval, book the day that already has the fewest cards due.

easyDays.label: Easy days
easyDays.help: Days to schedule less on. Reviews move by a day or two at most, never further.

ai.title: Artificial intelligence
ai.unavailable: No AI provider is configured yet. Add a key below to use AI features.

providers.placeholderDescription: Not wired up for generation yet — this only stores the key for when it is.

budget.label: Monthly budget
budget.hardBlock: Block calls once the cap is reached
budget.alert: The monthly AI budget is {threshold}% spent ({spent}).

allowlist.label: Privacy allow-list
allowlist.description: Only checked providers may be used. Uncheck a provider you never want a call routed to.
